description.value: Flourishing Chinese Seafood Restaurant is a family-owned Cantonese and Szechuan restaurant that has served the Langley community on Fraser Highway for over 25 years. The menu spans dim sum on Sundays, hot pot, sizzling teppan platters, fresh seafood, and customizable lunch combinations. A touring cyclist can order in, take out, or have food delivered, with customization available for dietary needs.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 82m; stands (4 spaces) at 93m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, operating dine-in Chinese restaurant at 20472 Fraser Highway, Langley, BC with phone 604-534-3335 — consistent with OSM except the OSM name 'Flourishing Restaurant' is shorter than the website's consistent 'Flourishing Chinese Seafood Restaurant'. The homepage explicitly states 'Dine-in, take out, delivery and catering!' confirming takeout, and the menu page notes 'vegetarian and gluten-free options are available upon request.' No website content mentions bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenity, so those are null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Flourishing Restaurant' but the website consistently uses 'Flourishing Chinese Seafood Restaurant' throughout all pages.
OSM has no phone number; phone 604-534-3335 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, long-established restaurant open to the public along Fraser Highway — a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a full sit-down or takeout meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page states 'No ADDED MSG; vegetarian and gluten-free options are available upon request.'
